prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 5 tests.
Finish hint, adoption layout, and home wait info changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Cloud sync assurance sign in redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen with a full-bleed layout showcasing persistent cloud pet backup and account sync security. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making cloud sync assurance critical at sign-in.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Welcome story overview new screen: Add a new introductory screen before path selection that introduces the companion pet experience with animated visuals. (why: 78.9% choose_path conversion with a long mean duration (514s) indicates users need clearer context before choosing a path.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Photo preparation guide new screen in adoption: Add a dedicated visual preparation guide screen before uploading custom photos to ensure high-quality custom pet creation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drops to 68.5%.)
3: [adoption, copy] Custom pet style upload guidance copy update: Update headline and body text on the pick friend step emphasizing customizable species traits. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
4: [home, notification] Background rendering completion system notification: Enable desktop system notifications when pet generation completes while the window is in the background. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s), causing drop-off if users navigate away during render.)
5: [home, wait_info] Step by step pet generation wait info status: Display detailed generation progress steps with step counter and active process indicator during waiting. (why: Home step waiting time has a high mean (2336s), leaving users unsure of background activity.)

scores.note: Strong win rate for sign_in redesign (3/4 tests) and strong support email evidence.
Adding a screen introduces friction; past choose_path new_screen test lost conversion (-3.2%).
High drop-off step with direct support mail backing, though new screens add release overhead.
Very low cost copy tweak directly addressing user confusion on a high-friction step.
Target step already has high conversion (89.3%) and notification tests previously failed.
Home wait info changes showed no clear effect in past tests (+0.5% baseline). Target step drop is low.
